items.t: Said he believes the school tuition bill punishes children for the wrongdoing of their parents.
items.q: I believe that we are punishing children for the wrongdoing of their parents.

items.t: Said that new legal guidance from the Attorney General raised constitutional concerns about the school flag legislation.
items.q: After receiving new legal guidance from the Attorney General, there are constitutional concerns about this legislation and its ability to survive a First Amendment constitutional challenge,

items.t: Wants to continue working to pass a constitutionally sound law banning certain flags from schools.
items.q: The best path forward is to continue to work on this issue so that we can pass a constitutionally sound law to ban divisive flags from schools once and for all.

record.t: Voted against the Senate bill allowing schools to charge tuition to students who cannot prove legal residency.
record.q: Republicans who opposed the measure included Sens. Richard Briggs (Knoxville), Todd Gardenhire (Chattanooga), Ferrell Haile (Gallatin), Becky Massey (Knoxville), Mark Pody (Lebanon)

record.t: Voted for the school flag ban legislation in committee.
record.q: As a conservative, I support the legislation in principle, which is why I voted for it in committee.
